caption: A white cue ball rolls straight into a red ball sitting still on a pool table; the red ball rolls away and the cue ball stops.

sa.check: A white cue ball and a red ball are on a pool table.
The cue ball rolls into the red ball, which is still before contact.
After contact the red ball rolls away and the cue ball is stopped or nearly stopped.
The cue ball approaches on a straight path.
The moving ball is white and the struck ball is red.

pc.expect: The red ball is set in motion by the contact: it starts moving at the moment the cue ball reaches it, not before and not without it.
pc.fail: The cue ball touches the red ball and the red ball does not move; or the red ball starts rolling before the cue ball arrives; or the cue ball stops short of the red ball and the red ball rolls away anyway.

pc.expect: After a head-on hit the red ball leaves along the cue ball's line of approach and the cue ball's speed drops sharply, so the red ball is the faster of the two afterwards.
pc.fail: The red ball leaves at a sharp angle or back toward the cue ball after a square hit; or the cue ball keeps rolling at its previous speed after the hit; or both balls move off together at the same speed in the same direction.

pc.expect: Once moving, each ball rolls straight and slows gradually; a ball at rest stays at rest until struck.
pc.fail: A ball curves or changes direction on the open cloth with nothing touching it; or speeds up on its own; or a stopped ball starts rolling again untouched.

pc.expect: The balls are hard and round: the contact is a brief click and each ball keeps its shape.
pc.fail: A ball dents or flattens at the contact; or the balls stick together and travel as a pair; or a ball wobbles like jelly.

pc.expect: Two balls remain two balls; neither passes into the other or through the table.
pc.fail: The balls overlap or pass through each other; or a ball vanishes, splits or a third ball appears; or a ball sinks into the cloth.

pc.expect: The balls keep their colours and the table markings stay put.
pc.fail: The cue ball turns red or the red ball turns white; or the balls swap colours after contact; or table spots and lines shift between frames.
